intent.title: Code panel shows the generated HTML and CSS
steps: Switch between the HTML and CSS tabs.
Change a style and insert an element.
expected: View > Code opens the Code panel as a tab in the bottom workbench.
The panel shows index.html and styles.css with line numbers and syntax colouring, identical to the files the export writes.
It can be resized and floated like other panels.

intent.title: Code panel follows the selection
steps: Open the Code panel and select an element on the canvas.
Click a line inside another element's markup in the HTML tab.
expected: Selecting an element highlights its markup lines in HTML and its rules in CSS and scrolls them into view.
Clicking inside an element's markup selects that element on the canvas and in Layers.

intent.title: Copy or download what the Code panel shows
steps: In the Code panel click 'Copy this pane' [codePanel.copyPane].
expected: The clipboard receives exactly the text of the open tab.
The download is the open file (index.html or styles.css) with exactly the shown content.

intent.title: Edit an element's CSS in the Code panel
steps: Select a Heading and open the CSS tab.
Edit its rule: change a value, add a declaration, remove one, then apply.
expected: Applying replaces the element's styles in the document JSON with the declarations of its rule as one undo step; the inspector and canvas update.
Invalid CSS is refused with the line and reason, and the document JSON is unchanged.
The rule is edited for the active breakpoint and state.

intent.title: Edit HTML in the Code panel
steps: Select a Section and open the HTML tab.
Edit its markup: change a text, add a paragraph, change an attribute; apply.
Type markup that breaks the nesting rules (an li outside a list) and apply; type unparsable markup and apply.
expected: Applying parses the markup with the HTML importer's rules and replaces the element's subtree in the document JSON as one undo step; the canvas, Layers and the inspector update.
Unchanged nodes keep their ids, names and styles.
Markup that breaks the nesting rules or cannot be parsed is refused with the line and the reason, and the document JSON is unchanged.
